claim: Cisco's disclosed revenue totaled $14 million during Q4 of fiscal 2024.
summary: Cisco's Q4 FY2024 revenue was on the order of $13-14 billion, not $14 million; the claimed $14 million figure is off by a factor of ~1000 and is contradicted by general knowledge.
